The PostToolUse hook runs a fast syntax check on any .py file right after Claude edits/writes it, so mistakes surface immediately in-session rather than at docker-compose-up. The first PreToolUse hook blocks Read/Bash from reaching .env (real secrets) while leaving .env.example untouched. The second logs every Bash command (+ why it was run) to a gitignored local file. Dev-time only; none of this runs when the app serves traffic.
